name: Cancellation rebook
description: When a closing call is cancelled before its start, send the rebook link by text and email (a cancel after the start, a host clearing a no-show's slot, is not a cancel, D73).

nodes.template: Hey {{contact.first_name | default:there}}, saw the call got cancelled. If you want to pick a new time, here you go: {{calendar.closer_call.url}}
nodes.title: Text the rebooking link

nodes.subject: Pick a new time?
nodes.template:
Hey {{contact.first_name | default:there}},

Saw the call got cancelled. No problem at all. If you'd like to pick a new time, here's the link: {{calendar.closer_call.url}}
